g.text: Analyze stage on services: hOCR ∥ layout, fused per batch (orchestrator side implemented, 2026-11-16)
The services only read the cleaned page; a mask is applied to their private copy. The layout attempt dir is deleted once
fused; the hOCR dir stays while a page points into it. Stamp and sticker proposals (the in-process heuristic) are not produced on this path.
